title: Layer 2 round 1 major QE: the live-tree substrate test fails on any fresh clone or CI runner
description: shell_red_gate.rs:92 asserts no substrate entry fails on the repo tree, but per-clone payload entries (hooks, mcp servers) are gitignored — absent on a fresh checkout or CI, so the positive test fails everywhere but this working copy; it also cannot see the githook prose-path declassification because that entry never reaches a fail on this tree. Disposition: build the positive fixture as a controlled temp tree with the expected payloads present, not the live estate. Owner: quality-engineer. Validator: software-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: the substrate positive builds the tree the manifest describes in a temp directory instead of trusting the live checkout — home-anchored entries excluded by construction (a test must not fabricate artifacts in the operator's home; none exist among entries today). The inconclusive set is pinned: githook-wiring asserted present, every member either a prose-path entry or a present exists-and-referenced entry, nothing else tolerated. Three pure normalizer tests added (any-remote strip + HEAD skip + dedup; local origin/x preserved; nested paths intact).
